name: Chad Merritt Trophy
notes: Introduced at the tournament's own preview show as originally designed to be TEAM's own Most Valuable Wrestler award before being repurposed, that same broadcast, as the Invitational Tournament's own prize; named for Chad Merritt, a CSWA authority figure.
epitaph: The prize of TEAM's own first Invitational Tournament, a three-tiered trophy named for one of the circuit's own founding figures and first held by an Englishman who beat five other men from five different federations to claim it.

name: TEAM Championship of Champions
notes: Established between this wing's own first and second eras (the era map's own title-history document dates it to shortly after the first TEAM Invitational Tournament); the title's own establishment and its first champion's own coronation are not captured in this era's own page set, only D!'s standing reign by the time of SuperShow I. Declared vacant at the 2006 Dupree Cup Finals after D! was fired by New Alberta Professional Wrestling for backstage conduct; a vacant-title match (Mr. Amazing! vs. Jake Hix) was set for SuperShow II, outside this era's own window.
epitaph: TEAM's own top prize, held for most of its first year by an underdog Canadian one-night-tournament winner before a real-world firing forced the league to strip it and start over.

name: TEAM FREE FOR ALL~! Championship
notes: An open-invitational title with no rankings or banked shots; any battle royal or gauntlet TEAM books for it crowns the next champion.
epitaph: TEAM's own no-rules prize, open to any comer bold enough to enter the ring, changing hands three times in its first year.

name: TEAM Challenge Championship
notes: Contested under a different gimmick match each time it changes hands (a steel cage at its debut, later falls-count-anywhere and lumberjack matches).
epitaph: A prize purpose-built to test its holders under a new gimmick every time it's on the line, held throughout its first year by one man.

name: TEAM Lethal Lottery Championship
notes: A tag title contested by randomly-paired wrestlers in a gauntlet format; no rankings or banked shots.
epitaph: TEAM's own randomizer of a tag title, first claimed by two men drawn together only for the night.

name: Harvard Avalon Memorial Trophy
epitaph: The trophy for TEAM's 2008 Tournament of Champions, won by Tyler Rayne; the one winner the record holds.
